_comment: Measured cells for the native-conv-layout expert linear tiles. profile_seg, 50 iters, 3 interleaved repeats per (tile, backend), performance governor on all 8 cores, gap phase 3000 us; the value is the median of the three gap medians. Every (tile, backend) here has a real context binary on the board. DSP repeats were noticeably noisier than cpu/hta (nc_qkv 1633-3131, nc_mlp 2495-4192) -- treat the dsp column as indicative. Also carries the DECODE linear blocks (smolvla_expert_decode_linear/*, seq 50 vs prefill's 113). No accelerator wins any of them -- cpu takes qkv and o_proj outright and ncd_mlp is a 1.3% tie with dsp, inside dsp's own spread. These cells exist so a scheduler sees the real cost and places them on cpu; there is deliberately NO decode binding manifest, because no context binaries for them are resident on the board.
